name: Addison Junction

ordinances.description: Changing from C-1, PD, and UC to a new PD to allow trainsit oriented mixed use development
Development plan for multifamily residential building, retail/restaurants, road realignment

Approval of a development plan for lots 1 and 5X, block A, Addison Circle Station-Phase 1, to allow for the development of an office building with ground floor retail/restaurant uses, a parking structure, and site access drives.
Construction of emergency access drives, pedestrian ways, Festival Way streetscape improvements
Approval of development plan for multifamily residential building with retail/restaurant uses and streetscape improvements.
Rezoning 15.5 acres from Commercial General and Planned Development to a new transit-oriented mixed-use Planned Development (Case 1947-Z, Addison Junction)

uses.name: Recreation facility, outdoor
uses.quote: Permitted Uses: A. Recreation Facility, Outdoor.

uses.name: Brewpub, distillery, or winery
uses.quote: B. Brewpub, Distillery, or Winery (allowed by Special Use Permit).

uses.text: Entertainment or event facility, indoor or outdoor (a commercial entertainment or event use for cultural, recreational, artistic, athletic or social events; it does not include adult entertainment, casinos, nightclubs or private event venues)

notes: Development plans must follow the permitted uses and standards (Exhibit B) and the concept plan (Exhibit C).
Final planned development site plan approval is required before a permit for site infrastructure.
The number of parking spaces, shared parking and the retail parking in the parking structures depend on the agreements between the Town and the developer.
Rooftop mechanical equipment must be screened from view from all rights-of-way.
Solid waste and recycling should be shared where feasible, and dumpsters and compactors may not stand free on the site.
